description: This file defines the main application widget for a Flutter app named SmartTutor. It sets up state management, routing, theme, and the bottom navigation bar with multiple screens including Home, Courses, Chat, Analytics, and Profile. The app dynamically adjusts the app bar title based on authentication status and intercepts navigation to the Profile tab if the user is unauthenticated to redirect to a login screen.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The root widget of the application, a StatefulWidget that manages bottom navigation and routing.

classes.name: _AppState
classes.description: State class for App, manages navigation state, initializes auth, and builds the MaterialApp widget.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the App widget.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Override to perform initialization that depends on inherited widgets, like starting auth provider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the app, including MaterialApp, Scaffold, AppBar, and BottomNavigationBar.
